description: Record a complete Chrome trace without the old 2,000-event cap, save .json/.json.gz, and return bottleneck summaries plus DevTools insight sets. Start, interact with the page, then stop; or use reload and autoStop. Drill down with browser_performance_analyze_insight.

action.description: Action: 'start' to begin recording, 'stop' to end and retrieve bottleneck insights

contextId.description: Optional isolated context; context tab IDs are negative

filePath.description: Raw trace output path (.json or .json.gz); default local artifacts directory
